text: By identifying possible contingencies and necessary rule revisions from venture capital investment data ex ante, before disruptive innovation creates problems, regulators could anticipate regulatory needs instead of reacting to them.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2740477

isBasedOn.name: Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation

abstract: By identifying possible contingencies and necessary rule revisions with optimized information from VC investments ex-ante, before disruptive innovation creates problems, regulators could anticipate regulatory needs.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: regulators integrate venture capital data into rulemaking processes or legislative proposals
